# Literary Terms

> A comprehensive educational resource providing definitions, examples, and analysis of literary terms, devices, and writing techniques with APA citation support.

Literary Terms is an educational glossary and reference site dedicated to helping students and writers understand literary concepts, rhetorical devices, genres, and writing styles. The site offers detailed definitions, practical examples, essay writing guides, and proper citation instructions for academic use.

## Key Topics

- Literary Devices
- Rhetorical Devices
- Poetry
- Prose
- Character
- Metaphor
- Satire
- Genres
- Literary Analysis
- Essay Writing
- APA Citation
- Rhetorical Question
- Narrative
- Persuasion
- Writing Techniques

## Core Reference

- [Literary Terms: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net): Homepage defining literary terms, techniques, and writing styles
- [Glossary of Literary Terms](https://literaryterms.net/glossary-of-literary-terms): Comprehensive glossary with definitions, explanations, and quizzes

## Literary Devices & Techniques

- [Rhetorical Device: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/rhetorical-device): Definition and examples of rhetorical devices for persuasion
- [Metaphor: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/metaphor): Definition and examples of metaphor as comparison device
- [Rhetorical Question: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/rhetorical-question): Definition and examples of rhetorical questions as literary device
- [Satire: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/satire): Definition and examples of satire using humor and irony

## Literary Forms & Genres

- [Poetry: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/poetry): Definition and examples of poetry with rhyme and meter
- [Prose: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/prose): Definition and examples of prose as non-verse writing
- [Genres](https://literaryterms.net/genres): Reference guide to literary genres including action, comedy, fantasy
- [Comedy: Definitions and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/comedy): Definition and examples of comedy genre across media

## Narrative & Character Elements

- [Character: Definitions and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/character): Definition and examples of character creation in literature
- [Story: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/story): Glossary entry defining story and narrative analysis
- [Persona: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/persona): Definition and examples of persona in dramatic and literary works

## Writing & Argumentation

- [Essay Guide](https://literaryterms.net/essay-guide): Guide for essay writing using literary terms and APA citations
- [Argument: Definition and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/argument): Definition and examples of persuasive arguments in writing

## Support & Citation

- [Cite us](https://literaryterms.net/cite-us): Instructions for citing Literary Terms using APA format

## Optional

- [Action: Definitions and Examples](https://literaryterms.net/action): Definition and examples of action genre in film and literature
